issues.t: Tow hitch wiring module can short and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from the rear of the vehicle, possibly while parked and switched off, on models with the factory or dealer tow hitch harness.
issues.why: Moisture and debris can get onto the circuit board in the tow hitch harness module and cause a short.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Park outside and away from buildings until the recall repair is done, and book it with a Kia dealer right away.

issues.t: Front power seat motor can overheat and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under a front seat, or a seat slide switch that feels stuck.
issues.why: The seat slide knob can stick and keep the motor powered until it overheats. Kia issued a second recall because the first repair did not always solve it.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Park outside and away from buildings until the latest recall repair is completed, even if the earlier repair was already done.

issues.t: Vehicle can roll away while in Park (recall)
issues.sym: The vehicle creeps or rolls after being shifted into Park, or you hear a grinding noise from the front when pulling away.
issues.why: The right front driveshaft and intermediate shaft may not be fully joined, and the splines can wear until Park no longer holds the wheels.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake when you park, and have the recall inspection and software update done right away.

issues.sym: A crack that appears after a small stone strike or with no obvious impact, often spreading quickly.
issues.why: Many owners report the windshield glass on early model years is unusually prone to cracking.
issues.next: A small chip can wait a short while, but have any crack in your line of sight repaired, and check whether your insurance covers glass.

issues.t: Seat belts may not hold a child seat tightly (recall)
issues.sym: A child seat installed with the seat belt will not stay snug because the belt does not lock.
issues.why: Some vehicles were built with seat belt assemblies meant for other markets that lack the locking feature used for child seats.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. Until it is fixed, install child seats with the lower anchors where possible.

issues.t: Trailer brake lights may not come on with smart cruise control (recall)
issues.sym: When towing with smart cruise control on, the trailer brake lights stay dark as the system slows the vehicle.
issues.why: The wiring does not send a brake light signal to the trailer when the cruise system applies the brakes by itself.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. Avoid using smart cruise control while towing until the extra harness is installed.

issues.t: High beam headlights can stop working (recall)
issues.sym: The high beams do not come on, or cut out, while the low beams still work.
issues.why: A fault in the headlight assembly can cause the high beam function to fail.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the headlights inspected soon, especially if you drive on unlit roads.

issues.t: Front passenger seat may not detect a child seat (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light shows the wrong state with a child seat in the front seat.
issues.why: The occupant detection unit in the front passenger seat may not recognise a child restraint correctly.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. Keep children in the rear seats, which is the safest place in any case.

issues.t: Instrument cluster screen can stay blank (recall)
issues.sym: The speedometer and warning light display stays dark after you start the vehicle.
issues.why: A software fault, or excess adhesive on the cluster circuit board on some vehicles, can stop the display from starting up.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: you may not see your speed or warning lights, so ease off, keep a safe distance, and pull over where it's safe. Restarting the car once parked may bring the display back; if it doesn't, have it fixed before you drive again. Check the VIN for the recalls. If the screen is blank, restart the vehicle before driving and have the repair done soon.

issues.t: Wrong-size spare tire fitted at the factory (recall)
issues.sym: With the spare installed, ABS or traction control warning lights may come on and the car may handle oddly.
issues.why: Some vehicles left the factory with a spare wheel and tire that do not match the size the brake and stability systems expect.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the spare inspected before you need it.

issues.t: Digital instrument cluster can show nothing at start-up (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge display stays blank when you start the vehicle, so speed and warning lights are not visible.
issues.why: A software error can prevent the cluster from loading.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If the screen is blank, restart the vehicle before driving and get the software update soon.

issues.t: Second-row side airbag wiring may be damaged (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on; often there is no symptom at all.
issues.why: The wiring to the second-row side airbags may have been damaged during assembly, so those airbags might not deploy in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the wiring inspected soon.

issues.t: Door window trim strip can peel and come off (recall)
issues.sym: The bright trim strip along the bottom of the door windows lifts, flaps in the wind, or goes missing.
issues.why: The outer layer of the belt molding can separate from its backing and detach while driving.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If a strip is loose, have it replaced soon so it does not fly off on the road.

issues.sym: Sudden loss of power, heavy shaking, loud engine noise, or the engine shutting off while driving.
issues.why: Some valve springs were made incorrectly and can fracture, which can let a valve drop and punch through the engine block.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If the engine starts running rough or loses power, pull over safely and have it towed.

issues.t: Front seat back frames may not hold in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom; on affected power front seats the seat back might feel loose.
issues.why: A manufacturing error in the front seat back frames means they may not restrain an occupant properly in a collision.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the seat frames inspected as soon as possible.

issues.t: Wrong-size spare tire fitted at the factory (recall)
issues.sym: With the spare installed, ABS or traction control warning lights may come on and the car may handle oddly.
issues.why: Some vehicles left the factory with a spare wheel and tire that do not match the size the brake and stability systems expect.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the spare inspected before you need it.

issues.t: Third-row centre seat belt buckle may not latch (recall)
issues.sym: The third-row middle seat belt will not click in, or pulls back out.
issues.why: The anchor buckle for the third-row centre seat may not latch properly.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and do not seat anyone in that position until the buckle is replaced.

issues.t: Driver seat belt can lock and refuse to pull out (recall)
issues.sym: The driver seat belt jams and will not extend far enough to buckle.
issues.why: The emergency locking mechanism in the driver belt retractor can lock when it should not.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and do not drive unbelted; have the belt assembly replaced first.
